IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.PRINT: all aggTrades of one taker side in the same ms, summed; kept if notional >= $1,000
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.CHAIN_SEED: triplet z<y<x with |(x-y)-(y-z)| <= tau, gaps in [2 s, 300 s]
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.CHAIN_EXTENSION: gap within tau of last+P, or of last+2P when the previous gap was not a miss; best = most slices; period = running mean over gap units
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.DETECTION_BUFFER: each month is detected on [month start - 6 h, month end + 6 h]; episodes kept by T in month
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.EPISODE_MERGE: overlapping same-side qualified chains; T = earliest qualifying print; end = latest chain end
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.REFRACTORY: same side, 6 h after each kept T
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.ANCHOR: t0 = first minute boundary strictly after T; e0 = first minute boundary strictly after the declared end
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.PRICE: last trade price at or before the time (minute close, carried forward)
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.DATA_GAP: a minute with no aggTrade inside a required window
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.PERSISTENCE_ELIGIBLE: t0 >= surface start + 30 d; [t0-61m, t0+60m) complete; t0+60m <= surface end
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.H6_ELIGIBLE: persistence eligible and [t0, t0+6h) complete within the surface
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.END_IDENTIFIED: persistence eligible; [chain start, e0) complete; end within surface
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.POST_END_1H_COMPLETE: end identified and [e0-61m, e0+60m) complete within surface
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.CONTROL_POOL: 5-minute grid of the surface; >= 30 d after surface start; [g-61m, g+6h) complete; no detected episode T (both sides, before refractory) within +-6 h
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.MATCH_CELL: UTC hour x RV60 tercile x NET60 quintile x sign(ret60); thresholds per UTC day from grid values in [d-30d, d)
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.RV60: sqrt(sum of squared 1-minute log returns over the 60 minutes before the anchor)
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.NET60: taker buy minus taker sell notional over the 60 minutes before the anchor
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.CONTROLS: up to 5 nearest in time, without replacement, anchors processed in time order; one matching run for t0 anchors (H1, H2) and one for e0 anchors (H3)
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.NO_CONTROL: anchor with zero controls is excluded from that test
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.H1_VALUE: log((episode same-side notional in [t0, t0+60m) + 1) / (mean control same-side notional + 1)); side = episode side
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.H2_VALUE: side * log(p(t0+h)/p(t0)) - mean over controls of side * log(p(g+h)/p(g)), h in {1h, 6h}; 6h only for H6-eligible anchors
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.H3_VALUE: side * log(p(e0+1h)/p(e0)) - mean over controls (matched at e0) of the same
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.BOOTSTRAP: UTC-day blocks of the anchor, resampled with replacement; numpy default_rng(seed) per test
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.P_REPLICATION: (1 + #{s(b - m) >= s m}) / (B + 1), s = sign of the discovery estimate
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.HOLM: m = 3 cells always (H2_1h, H2_6h, H3); a cell not run counts as p = 1
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.HETEROGENEITY_BLOCKS: 26-week blocks implemented as calendar half-years (Jan-Jun, Jul-Dec) so each block lies in one epoch; epochs are calendar years; permutation reassigns blocks across years keeping each year's block count; the observed SD of yearly means is the identity draw
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.HETEROGENEITY_SUPPORTED: if the planned outcome-blind assessability of a cell is NOT_ASSESSABLE, its gate result is NOT_ASSESSABLE and is not a failure (plan section 8); the computed test is then reported as a non-deciding diagnostic and never as stability. Otherwise a cell passing Holm and the floor is supported unless the gate outcome is HETEROGENEOUS_UNEXPLAINED
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.HETEROGENEITY_DIAGNOSTICS: largest epoch share and leave-one-epoch-out means are reported and never decide
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.FINAL_CLASSIFICATION: H1 fail -> MECHANISM_NOT_SUPPORTED; H1 pass and no supported price cell -> MECHANISM_SUPPORTED_PRICE_EFFECT_NOT_SUPPORTED; at least one supported cell and the replication support gate failed -> DISCOVERY_SUPPORTED_REPLICATION_INSUFFICIENT; every supported cell replicates -> SUPPORTED_WITH_REPLICATION; otherwise DISCOVERY_SUPPORTED_REPLICATION_FAILED; cells are always reported individually, with the H3 sign (negative = reversal, the temporary-impact fingerprint)
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.HETEROGENEITY_ASSESSABILITY: outcome-blind: per-episode SD = unconditional h-return SD x sqrt(1 + 1/5); difference = 10 bps between the two smallest years; two-sided alpha 0.05; NOT_ASSESSABLE if power < 0.50
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.REPLICATION_H1: computed on the replication surface and reported descriptively, only if the replication support gate passes; replication classification uses the frozen cell rule only
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.REPLICATION_GATE_FAILED: no replication outcome (flow or price) is computed; replication status INFERENCE_INSUFFICIENT; no substitute surface
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS_FROZEN_BEFORE_OUT.HETEROGENEITY_POWER_PROXY: the V1 '2x difference between epochs' is operationalised as floor (10 bps) versus 2 x floor (20 bps) in the two smallest years, i.e. a 10 bps difference, two-sample z approximation
